name: South Africa
combinedSummary: Exercise increased caution in South Africa.

us.summary:
Updated to reflect information on driving at night and addition of the terrorism risk indicator. 
Exercise increased caution in South Africa due to crime, terrorism, civil unrest, and kidnapping. 
Advisory summary: Violent crime is common and includes robbery, rape, carjacking and mugging. There are also "smash-and-grab" attacks on vehicles. Violent crime is more common in the downtown areas of big cities, especially after dark. Kidnapping is a threat in South Africa.
